units.source_text: 少年时代，我没有自己的家，也没有家庭。

en.t: In my boyhood, I had no home of my own and no family either.

units.source_text: 学校放假，也寄食于亲戚家，从这家到那家，走亲串戚。

en.t: When school was on vacation, I would stay with relatives, going from one house to another and visiting kin.

units.source_text: 大部分假期，我通常是在两户近亲家度过的。

en.t: I usually spent most of my holidays at the homes of two close relatives.

units.source_text: 这两家坐落在淀川的南北两侧。

en.t: These two households were located on the north and south sides of the Yodo River.

units.source_text: 一家是在河内地区的城镇，一家是在摄津地区的乡村。

en.t: One was in a town in the Kawachi region, and the other was in a village in the Settsu region.
I traveled back and forth between them by ferry.

units.source_text: 无论到哪家，他们都很欢迎我，不是说“你来了”，而是说“你回来了”。

en.t: Whichever house I went to, they welcomed me warmly, saying not “You have come,” but “You have come home.”
